name: no-update-outcome-is-not-a-successful-update
find: guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else { return nil }
replace: guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else { return Outcome(ok: true, exitCode: 0, phase: "", message: "", finishedAt: Date()) }
breaks: an update with no recorded ending reads as one that finished successfully, which is the state for the whole several minutes a build takes and also the state when the updater died without writing anything. The progress would come off the screen while the work carried on, and a failure nobody recorded would report as a success (L98, #686)
